recorded_before: any V5 or V6 search (written and committed first)
forbidden_note: seed 7 was used in a feasibility run before this plan; it is never used here
search_tool: volcano-rho (census min-n-patched build): --bits 26 --depth D [--crater split|--j0] --ell L --seed S --min-n 262144 --max-cofactor 64 --trials 1 --per-level 1 --controls 0
walk_tool: ca volcano --p P --a A --b B --ell L --seed 20261023 --trials 1 --per-level 0 --controls 0 --radius 40 --max-vertices 20000
rule: for i = 0,1,2,...: run the search with seed = stream + i; walk the hit whole with ca; take the FIRST hit that satisfies the volcano's criteria; every rejected seed (also a seed with no curve, or a failed walk) and its reason is logged in census/search_log.jsonl. Size and shape rules only; no outcome is read.

criteria.common: walk complete (no vertex with level -1, vertices = sum of per_level, vertices < max-vertices), n = largest prime factor of #E with n >= 2^18, cofactor <= 64, n not divisible by ell
criteria.V5: ell=2, depth=6, j=0 crater (--j0; inert, one vertex), p = 1 mod 8, 3 | n-1 (rho.cubic needs it; the tool cannot filter on it, so it is tested on every hit and rejects are logged), per_level = [1,1,2,4,8,16,32] (64 vertices), special_j_skipped = number of level-1 vertices (the single up-edge back to j=0 each) and nothing else
criteria.V6: ell=3, depth=4, crater split, special_j_skipped = 0, vertices <= 2000 (decided on the ca walk)
